title: Machine learning-based prediction of postoperative continuous renal replacement therapy initiation after open thoracoabdominal aortic repair.
summary: LightGBM predicts postoperative CRRT initiation after open thoracoabdominal aortic repair in 372 patients, with internal test/bootstrapped AUC 0.814; six perioperative variables were influential. This is exploratory single-center prediction with 66 events and no external validation. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
